_meta.title: Hycarfilter Specification Evidence Register
_meta.purpose: Per-field evidence annotation for every SKU. Each value carries a value_type, source, confirmation status and note so the site renders honest "Data basis" tags and never presents a seed value as a verified measurement or certificate.

value_types.measured: Measured — verified by test or measurement against a stated standard.
value_types.design-target: Design target — engineering target value, confirmed against the OE drawing / sample.
value_types.typical: Typical — representative or nominal value; confirm per order.
value_types.reference: Reference — for guidance only; confirm against the spec sheet or sample before ordering.
value_types.promotional: Promotional — marketing claim, not a verified specification.

confirmation_statuses.confirmed: Verified against a test report or sample.
confirmation_statuses.pending-sample: To be confirmed against the pre-production sample.
confirmation_statuses.pending-order: To be confirmed at order confirmation.
confirmation_statuses.unverified: Not yet verified; treat as reference only.

filtration_efficiency.note: No test standard, test dust or particle size stated on the seed value. Confirm against an ISO 5011 / SAE J726 report for the exact SKU before quoting.
